title: Vampire Vape Nicit Up Salts 50/50 Nic Shot 10ml 20mg
description: NicIt Up are a line of Nicotine Shots from UK Vape brand Vampire Vape. NicIt Up nic shots let you tailor the nicotine content of your favourite 50ml and 100ml 0mg shortfill e-liquids so you can enjoy just the right amount of nicotine satisfaction in a long-lasting bottle of e-liquid. They come in a variety of PG/VG ratios and include Nicotine Salt formulations. Nic It Up Salts by Vampire Vape is designed to provide a perfect nicotine salt experience with your favourite e-liquids. Not be vaped on its own.
